notes.title: Public Beta Testing - SEP 25
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42124012/44b050fd374827a6d3a23692c07212f6ede2e641.png"][/img][/p][p]🏝️ [b]Public Beta Sign-Ups are OPEN![/b] 🏝️[/p][p][/p][p]Survivors, it’s finally time — we’re opening the gates to the next Public Beta![/p][p][/p][p]If you want to play, test, and contribute to the future of our game, this is your chance. Your feedback will help us improve survival mechanics, squash bugs, and make the adventure even better.[/p][p][/p][p]Survivors who contribute feedback/bug reports will be able to keep their role and have exclusive sections in the future![/p][p][/p][p]👉 [b]How to join:[/b][/p][p][/p][p]1. Join our [url="https://discord.gg/6u2ytRkatN"]Official Discord[/url].[/p][p]2. Fill out the sign-up form [url="https://forms.gle/9ogUwjptFjTjVtAU8"]HERE[/url].[/p][p][/p][p]The sign-up form will be available until [b]October 6th[/b].[/p][p][/p][p]See you on the islands 🌴✨[/p]

notes.title: Dev Diary - 18 SEP 25
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42124012/b27b169bb69a896b1dc48d87b896a0da5b1471cf.png"][/img][/p][p]Hello Survivors, 🏝️💀[/p][p][/p][p]Starting now, you’ll begin to see more regular posts here on Steam, keeping you in the loop about our development progress as the game moves closer to Early Access![/p][p][/p][p]Take a look at my dev diaries to see how I am building the game, upcoming features, challenges I am facing while shaping your survival experience, and development insights.[/p][p][/p][p][b][u]Internal Update[/u][/b][/p][list][*][p]Added screen effects for hunger, thirst, low health, and infection[/p][/*][*][p]Added new AI - spider[/p][/*][*][p]Added passive insects that can crawl on you[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed hand positions when holding certain weapons[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where clothing wouldn't appear in the inventory after loading a save[/p][/*][*][p]Added the ability to change the color of the watch[/p][/*][*][p]Changed the item pickup animation[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where the shadow of headwear wasn't visible[/p][/*][*][p]Improved arrow hits on animals and enemies[/p][/*][*][p]New effects for wood and stone mining[/p][/*][*][p]Added a visual trail that cuts through the air for all throwables[/p][/*][*][p]Other minor changes and fixes[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b][u]Insect Test (Spoiler):[/u][/b][/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="csPnHLc4BWA;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p][b][u]Updated Roamap Incoming:[/u][/b][/p][p]I know many of you are curious about what’s ahead. The game roadmap is currently being refreshed to better reflect our goals and your feedback, and you may expect a new version soon.[/p][p][/p][p]👉 Want to chat with me directly and meet fellow survivors? [url="https://discord.gg/6u2ytRkatN"]Join our Discord[/url]. [/p][p][/p][p]Don't forget to wish-list the game:[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1755080/Away_From_Life/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]Stay safe, stay resourceful,[/p][p][b][i]Anton - Developer[/i][/b][/p]

notes.title: Playtest | Discord
notes.content:
Hello everyone, I want to inform you that testing of the full version of the game will begin soon, anyone who wants to take part in testing can apply on the [url=https://discord.gg/2xQQew3KaB]Discord game channel[/url].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42124012/3fe6f8c4cad7fe3c67ac9bf9484dad80aa666123.png[/img]
At the moment, you can already try the demo version of the game, do not hesitate to leave your feedback, it will help make the game better.
